name: Trinket Watcher
desc: Deploys what lands on master, with a version switch to go back.
about: Every five minutes it checks shiny-trinkets on GitHub. When another agent pushes, it checks the manifests, runs the changed gadgets' tests, and deploys them, tagging each build with its commit. Pick an older version of any gadget to switch back to it.

intents.phrase: …go back to an earlier version of a gadget
intents.desc: Each deploy is kept by its commit; switch any gadget back in one tap.
Recent pushes, what they changed, test output and the deploy result.

actions.label: Check now
actions.title: Look for new commits on master now
